sparqlExamples.label: Count triples by graph
Classes by number of instances
Properties by number of triples
Publishers
sparqlExamples.query:
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>

SELECT ?publisher (COUNT(*) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  ?x dct:publisher ?publisher
}
GROUP BY ?publisher
ORDER BY DESC(?count)

sparqlExamples.label: Publishers with DDC main subjects
sparqlExamples.query:
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX bartoc: <http://bartoc.org/en/node/>

SELECT ?publisher ?class ?label (COUNT(?terminology) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  ?terminology dct:publisher ?publisher .
  ?terminology dct:subject ?ddc .
  ?ddc skos:inScheme bartoc:241 .
  ?ddc skos:notation ?class .
  ?ddc skos:prefLabel ?label .
  FILTER (STRLEN(?class) = 1)
}
GROUP BY ?publisher ?class ?label
ORDER BY DESC(?count)

sparqlExamples.label: Terminologies by decade of creation
sparqlExamples.query:
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>

SELECT ?decade (COUNT(?terminology) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  ?terminology a skos:ConceptScheme .
  ?terminology schema:startDate ?date .
  BIND(CONCAT(SUBSTR(STR(?date), 1, 3), "0") AS ?decade)
}
GROUP BY ?decade
ORDER BY ?decade
